Name: Style
Description: Selects the style for the cracks, determining the overall appearance and pattern of the Lichtenberg figures.

Flubs.Name: A
Flubs.Description: Style A: Produces a classic branching crack pattern, suitable for general terrain fracturing.

Flubs.Name: B
Flubs.Description: Style B: Generates a denser, more intricate crack network for detailed surface effects.

Flubs.Name: C
Flubs.Description: Style C: Creates a sparse, wide-spread crack pattern, ideal for subtle terrain disruption.

Name: Scale
Description: Controls the scale of the larger cracks, affecting how prominent and wide the main crack structures appear.

Name: Complexity
Description: Adjusts the level of detail in the crack network. Higher values produce more branches and finer crack structures.

Name: Depth
Description: Sets the depth of the cracks, determining how deeply the cracks cut into the terrain surface.

Name: Expand
Description: Expands the cracks outward, increasing their coverage and making the crack network more pronounced.

Name: Bias
Description: Provides artistic control over the shape and direction of the cracks, allowing for customized crack patterns.

Name: Seed
Description: Random seed for generating the crack pattern. Changing the seed produces different crack arrangements while keeping other settings the same.
